stage: ais-features: feature set v3 for learned-choice (CONTRACT A16.1)
summary: learned-choice feature_set v3 = v1 (indices 0-7 unchanged) + est_prefill_ms_s, prefill_backlog_ms_s, est_ttft_ms_s, est_decode_step_ms_s, itl_externality_ms_s; new context sources min_est_ttft_ms_s, mean_est_decode_step_ms_s. Backlog = host PREFILL_TIME (router_prefill_load_model: ais); this request's prefill = host AIS prediction per worker through a new research input REQUEST_PREFILL_TIME (prefill_source: host) or an AIS closed form (closed_form); decode features = AIS-calibrated closed form (policy parameters). Isolated build 555ca082 (commit <commit-ais-01>). Existing policies (default@defaults, lmetric@defaults, v1 learned-choice m1-s2@sel-g30) are identical to the tier-A build on 6 train cells x k0,1: 36/36 records, every non-environment field (76) and 254,562 per-request rows; only build_id/cache_key and run-environment fields differ. CPU cluster bundle parity IDENTICAL on 3 node images (84/84 records each). The AIS host load model changes default@defaults' routing from the 7th-230th request on in 12/12 pairs but not its goodput beyond noise (windowed goodput ratio 1.0006 ± 0.0168, range 0.976-1.031).

feature_set_v3.notation: n_i = prompt tokens - accounting-estimate cached tokens on worker i (feature 2 numerator); L = prompt tokens; b_i = active requests; C_i = decode_cost_blocks x block_size

features.name: active_prefill_tokens_k
features.definition: v1 unchanged (under router_prefill_load_model: ais the host decays active prefill tokens over each prefill's AIS-predicted duration)

features.name: est_prefill_ms_s
features.definition: P_i/1000: modeled prefill time of this request's n_i uncached tokens after its cached prefix on worker i; 0 when n_i = 0
features.source: prefill_source host: host AIS prediction per worker (WorkerInputs::REQUEST_PREFILL_TIME, WorkerInputView::modeled_request_prefill_ms; the single-pass query predict_prefill_duration(1, n_i, L - n_i) that the backlog sums); prefill_source closed_form: a*n + b*n*(L - n/2) + c
features.live_router: host: AIS in-process (same PrefillLoadEstimator); the live queue does not fill REQUEST_PREFILL_TIME yet (UPSTREAM_FOLLOWUPS #15), so live uses closed_form until then

features.name: prefill_backlog_ms_s
features.definition: B_i/1000: host modeled prefill backlog (sum of active prefills' AIS predictions minus time elapsed since the oldest became active, so in-progress prefills count their remaining fraction; excludes this request)
features.source: host AIS (WorkerInputs::PREFILL_TIME, modeled_prefill_backlog_ms; needs router_prefill_load_model: ais)
features.live_router: AIS in-process (router_prefill_load_model: ais + ais_perf_config, lib/kv-router/src/scheduling/queue.rs, lib/llm/src/kv_router.rs); live completions arrive late and replica-synced values are anchored at receive time

features.name: est_ttft_ms_s
features.source: host AIS (+ closed form with prefill_source closed_form)

features.name: est_decode_step_ms_s
features.definition: (alpha + beta*(b_i + 1) + gamma*C_i)/1000: decode-step time once this request joins
features.live_router: same closed form over router-observable load

features.name: itl_externality_ms_s
features.definition: b_i*(beta + gamma*L)/1000: per-step increase this request imposes, summed over the b_i requests already on worker i (= 32 x feature 5 x (beta + gamma L)/1000)
features.why_times_b: beta + gamma*L alone is equal on every worker under the linear closed form and would cancel out of the choice

feature_set_v3.excluded: expected_output_tokens and the true OSL (unit test v3_ignores_expected_output_tokens)
feature_set_v3.duplication_invariance: all 13 features and all 8 sources are invariant under N -> 2N duplication (no v3 exception; unit test v3_duplication_keeps_features_sources_and_choice)
feature_set_v3.missing_inputs: a candidate without a host backlog (or without a host prefill prediction under prefill_source host) fails the decision with a message naming router_prefill_load_model: ais

parameters_yaml.validation: prefill_source and ais_closed_form required for v3 and rejected for v1/v2; prefill block required iff closed_form; every constant finite and >= 0; unknown keys rejected; v3-only sources rejected for v1/v2

known_limits: C_i counts the router's unique active blocks (shared prefixes once, no output tokens), so est_decode_step under-counts AIS's summed context on prefix-heavy workers (UPSTREAM_FOLLOWUPS #16)
The decode closed form smooths AIS: finite-difference AIS marginal steps are non-smooth (e.g. -0.007 ms at B=32, ctx 8192, L 8192 vs closed form 0.385 ms)

fit.weighting: least squares on relative error (weights 1/y), coefficients >= 0 (scipy bvls)

decode_step.form: decode_step_ms(B, S) = alpha + beta*B + gamma*S, B decode requests, S sum of their KV contexts

prefill.form: prefill_ms(n, L) = a*n + b*n*(L - n/2) + c, n >= 1 new tokens, L prompt tokens
prefill.target: AIS single forward pass (num_prefill_requests 1, sum_prefill_tokens n, sum_prefill_kv_tokens L - n): the router prefill-load model's per-request query
prefill.use: fallback only (prefill_source closed_form); the campaign default is prefill_source host (exact AIS) because of these errors

ais_load_model_effect_on_default.question: Does router_prefill_load_model: ais (host prefill-token decay over AIS-predicted durations) change default@defaults' own decisions or goodput in replay?
ais_load_model_effect_on_default.setup: default@defaults with router_config {router_prefill_load_model: ais} (+ engine ais_perf_config as the router estimator) vs default@defaults, same build, same 6 train cells x k0,1

decisions.note: first divergence at request rank 7-25 in open loop (arrivals exogenous, so the load model alone causes it) and 32-230 in closed loop; after that trajectories differ, so routing_changed_frac is not a per-decision rate

ais_load_model_effect_on_default.verdict: decisions change in every pair; windowed goodput does not change beyond noise (mean delta +0.06%, SE over cells 0.58%, pooled within-cell replicate sd 1.37%, cell means 0.988-1.027; 5 better, 7 worse pairs). Informal application of the contract's noise rule on 6 train cells x 2 replicates.
ais_load_model_effect_on_default.implication: M0-ais (default with the AIS load model) starts at default's goodput level; A16.3's single reference default@defaults without AIS stays appropriate, and M0-ais makes any tuned difference explicit.
